# The Monospace Web (vendored reference)

Upstream: <https://github.com/owickstrom/the-monospace-web> by Oskar Wickström,
MIT License (`LICENSE.md`). `index.css` and `index.js` are the unmodified
upstream sources at v0.1.5 (2025-08-20) kept for provenance and comparison.
Marshall does not bundle these files directly: the application stylesheet
`assets/css/monospace.css` is adapted from `index.css` (external font import
removed, colours moved to `assets/css/tokens.css`, rhythm rule scoped) and
`assets/js/grid.js` ports the grid helpers from `index.js`.
